name: Beacon Patrol

categories.label: Explored lighthouse tiles (incl. HQ)
categories.labelVi: Ô hải đăng đã khám phá (tính cả HQ)
categories.hint: Tile touching tiles on all 4 sides and showing a lighthouse or the HQ: 3 pts each

categories.label: Explored beacon buoy tiles
categories.labelVi: Ô phao tiêu đã khám phá
categories.hint: Fully explored tile with a beacon buoy: 2 pts each

categories.label: Other explored tiles
categories.hint: Every other fully explored tile: 1 pt each (no lighthouse or buoy)

categories.label: Windmills points (expansion)
categories.labelVi: Điểm cối xay gió (bản mở rộng)
categories.hint: Per fully explored windmill: 1 pt + 1 pt per adjacent open-ocean tile (orthogonal). Enter total

categories.label: Piers points (expansion)
categories.hint: Per fully explored pier: 1 pt + 1 pt per building on its connected landmass. Enter total

winCondition: Cooperative: no win or loss, the team compares its total to the rank table (base game: 0-25 Novices, 26-35 Sailors, 36-45 Captains, 46-55 Navigators, 56+ Cartographers; thresholds shift up by 10 per expansion used).

endCondition.description: Game ends when all tiles have been placed or discarded

notes: family: coop-explore-score. Only explored tiles (connected on all four sides) score. Solo campaign/objective variants exist as separate BGG files and are not modelled. Rank thresholds with 1 expansion: Novices 0-35, Sailors 36-45, Captains 46-55, Navigators 56-65, Cartographers 66+; with 2: 0-45, 46-55, 56-65, 66-75, 76+.
